faq.q: Are Hyde Park and Hyde Park Corner the same complex?
faq.a: No — the live page states Hyde Park Corner is a separate 16-townhome phase at 2828 156 Street, completed in 2021, with its own strata plan, so check which strata a listing belongs to before comparing fees or documents

faq.q: What should I check before buying at Hyde Park?
faq.a: Which strata the unit belongs to, then the package the live page itself names: the Form B information certificate, the strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report — plus the floor plan, since the page states tandem-garage, double-garage and main-floor primary bedroom layouts all exist in the complex

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Hyde Park South Surrey?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Hyde Park South Surrey is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
